title: The Distribution and Consequences of Natural Disasters: Evidence from U.S. Wildfire Victims
title_zh: 自然灾害的分布与后果：来自美国野火受害者的证据
title_primary: 自然灾害的分布与后果：来自美国野火受害者的证据
title_secondary: The Distribution and Consequences of Natural Disasters: Evidence from U.S. Wildfire Victims
authors: Patrick Baylis, Judson Boomhower, Jonathan M. Colmer, John L. Voorheis
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The economic burden of natural disasters is shaped by who is exposed, who experiences losses, how those losses alter individual economic trajectories, and how affected communities evolve in the aftermath. We link property-level damage data from over 100 U.S. wildfires to administrative tax and Census data to understand individual-level relationships between disaster damage and economic outcomes. Residents of burned areas are wealthier than the U.S. population on average, but within these wildfire perimeters the likelihood that a home burns is negatively correlated with pre-fire income. Home destruction imposes costs beyond rebuilding the property: occupants of destroyed homes experience lower income for three years post-fire, producing cumulative income losses equal to 26 percent of pre-fire annual income. We do not detect income or employment effects for residents without direct property damage. Community recovery is slow and accompanied by changes in composition. Four years after a fire, half of destroyed addresses remain unoccupied and reoccupied addresses house residents with substantially higher incomes than before.
abstract_zh: 自然灾害的经济负担取决于谁暴露于灾害、谁遭受损失、这些损失如何改变个人经济轨迹，以及受灾社区在灾后如何演变。我们将美国100多起野火的房产级损失数据与行政税务及人口普查数据相结合，以理解灾害损失与个人经济结果之间的关系。受灾区域的居民平均而言比美国总体人口更富裕，但在这些野火边界内，房屋被烧毁的可能性与火灾前收入呈负相关。房屋毁坏带来的成本远超重建房产本身：被毁房屋的居住者在火灾后三年内收入较低，累计收入损失相当于火灾前年收入的26%。对于未遭受直接财产损失的居民，我们未检测到收入或就业方面的影响。社区恢复缓慢，并伴随人口构成的变化。火灾四年后，一半被毁地址仍无人居住，而重新入住的地址所居住的居民收入显著高于灾前水平。

title: CoCo Design, Risk Shifting and Financial Fragility
title_zh: CoCo设计、风险转移与金融脆弱性
title_primary: CoCo设计、风险转移与金融脆弱性
title_secondary: CoCo Design, Risk Shifting and Financial Fragility
authors: Stephanie Chan, Sweder van Wijnbergen
official: 官方在线 2016-02-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Contingent convertible capital (CoCo) is a debt instrument that converts to equity or is written off if the issuing bank fails to meet a distress threshold. The conversion increases the issuer's loss-absorption capacity, but results in wealth transfers between CoCo holders and shareholders, which may change risk-shifting incentives to shareholders. Higher risk increases the probability of CoCo conversion, while lowering the wealth transfer. We show that for Principal-Write-Down (PWD) CoCos, the net effect is to always increase risk-shifting incentives, while for equity-converting CoCos, it depends on the extent of dilution after conversion. We integrate the analysis in a game-theoretic optimal capital regulation framework and show that use of PWD or insufficiently dilutive CE CoCos requires higher capital requirements for given asset structure to offset the rising risk-shifting incentives these instruments give rise to.
abstract_zh: 或有可转换资本（CoCo）是一种债务工具，当发行银行未能达到困境阈值时，其转换为股权或被减记。转换增强了发行人的损失吸收能力，但导致CoCo持有者与股东之间的财富转移，这可能改变股东的风险转移激励。更高的风险增加了CoCo转换的概率，同时降低了财富转移。我们证明，对于本金减记型（PWD）CoCo，净效应总是增加风险转移激励，而对于股权转换型CoCo，则取决于转换后的稀释程度。我们将此分析整合进一个博弈论最优资本监管框架中，并表明，在给定资产结构下，使用PWD或稀释不足的CE CoCo需要更高的资本要求，以抵消这些工具引发的不断上升的风险转移激励。

title: Robust Estimation of Double Autoregressive Models via Normal Mixture QMLE*
title_zh: 基于正态混合QMLE的双自回归模型稳健估计
title_primary: 基于正态混合QMLE的双自回归模型稳健估计
title_secondary: Robust Estimation of Double Autoregressive Models via Normal Mixture QMLE*
authors: Zhao Chen, Shi Chen, Christina Dan Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates the estimation of the double autoregressive (DAR) model in the presence of skewed and heavy-tailed innovations. We propose a novel Normal Mixture Quasi-Maximum Likelihood Estimation (NM-QMLE) method to address the limitations of conventional quasi-maximum likelihood estimation (QMLE) under non-Gaussian conditions. By incorporating a normal mixture distribution into the quasi-likelihood framework, NM-QMLE effectively captures both heavy-tailed behavior and skewness. A critical contribution of this paper is addressing the often-overlooked challenge of selecting the appropriate number of mixture components, $K$, a key parameter that significantly impacts model performance. We systematically evaluate the effectiveness of different model selection criteria. Under regularity conditions, we establish the consistency and asymptotic normality of the NM-QMLE estimator for DAR($p$) models. Numerical simulations demonstrate that NM-QMLE outperforms commonly adopted QMLE methods in terms of estimation accuracy, particularly when the innovation distribution deviates from normality. Our results also show that while criteria like BIC and ICL improve parameter estimation of $K$, fixing a small order of components provides comparable accuracy. To further validate its practical applicability, we apply NM-QMLE to empirical data from the S\&P 500 index and assess its performance through Value at Risk (VaR) estimation. The empirical findings highlight the effectiveness of NM-QMLE in modeling real-world financial data and improving risk assessment. By providing a robust and flexible estimation approach, NM-QMLE enhances the analysis of time series models with complex innovation structures, making it a valuable tool in econometrics and financial modeling.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在存在偏态和重尾创新情形下双自回归（DAR）模型的估计问题。我们提出了一种新颖的正态混合拟极大似然估计（NM-QMLE）方法，以解决传统拟极大似然估计（QMLE）在非高斯条件下的局限性。通过将正态混合分布纳入拟似然框架，NM-QMLE有效捕捉了重尾行为和偏态特性。本文的一个关键贡献在于处理了常被忽视的混合成分数量\(K\)的选择难题，这一关键参数对模型性能有显著影响。我们系统评估了不同模型选择标准的有效性。在正则条件下，我们确立了NM-QMLE估计量对于DAR(\(p\))模型的一致性和渐近正态性。数值模拟表明，当创新分布偏离正态时，NM-QMLE在估计精度上优于常用的QMLE方法。我们的结果还显示，尽管BIC和ICL等准则能改善参数\(K\)的估计，但固定较小阶数的成分也能提供相当的精度。为进一步验证其实用性，我们将NM-QMLE应用于标普500指数的实证数据，并通过风险价值（VaR）估计评估其性能。实证结果凸显了NM-QMLE在建模真实金融数据和改进风险评估方面的有效性。通过提供一种稳健且灵活的估计方法，NM-QMLE增强了对具有复杂创新结构的时间序列模型的分析，使其成为计量经济学和金融建模中的宝贵工具。

title: Sociological rational choice theory: retrospect and prospect
title_zh: 社会学理性选择理论：回顾与展望
title_primary: 社会学理性选择理论：回顾与展望
title_secondary: Sociological rational choice theory: retrospect and prospect
authors: Edgar Kiser, Steven Pfaff, Blaine Robbins
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Sociological rational choice theory (SRT) is a theoretical approach that values scientifically driven, theoretically grounded research, combining the methodological individualism and instrumental microfoundations used in economics with models of institutions, networks, and norms from sociology. Inspired by the public choice movement, SRT sought to apply rational choice theory to non-market behavior and the collective results of that behavior. At the time of its inception, SRT distanced itself from social exchange theory and the main lines of social network analysis. Whereas exchange theory readily incorporated network concepts and rooted itself in social psychology, advocates for rational choice pursued a strategy based on strong assumptions about individual rationality combined with a more flexible conception of bounded rationality. Despite being promoted by leading sociologists, SRT never attained a position at the center of the discipline, and debate on rational choice gradually died out. Mounting criticism of the rational action model in philosophy, cognitive psychology, and behavioral economics also took a toll on the appeal of rational choice and the confidence of its practitioners. Nevertheless, we conclude on an encouraging note. While American sociology has shown declining interest and involvement in SRT, new directions drawing on social network analysis, experimental methods, and efforts to adapt the dual-process framework of behavior show great promise. To some extent, rational choice sociology informs a vital part of the discipline in the United States and particularly in Europe.
abstract_zh: 社会学理性选择理论（SRT）是一种重视科学驱动、理论扎实的研究方法，它将经济学中的方法论个人主义和工具性微观基础与社会学中的制度、网络和规范模型相结合。受公共选择运动的启发，SRT旨在将理性选择理论应用于非市场行为及其集体结果。在其创立之初，SRT与社会交换理论及社会网络分析的主要流派保持距离。交换理论易于融入网络概念并植根于社会心理学，而理性选择的倡导者则采取了一种基于个体理性强假设与有限理性更灵活概念相结合的策略。尽管得到了顶尖社会学家的推崇，SRT从未成为学科核心，关于理性选择的辩论也逐渐消退。哲学、认知心理学和行为经济学中对理性行动模型的日益批评，也削弱了理性选择的吸引力及其实践者的信心。尽管如此，我们以鼓舞人心的结论收尾。虽然美国社会学对SRT的兴趣和参与度有所下降，但借鉴社会网络分析、实验方法以及适应行为双过程框架的新方向展现出巨大潜力。在某种程度上，理性选择社会学为美国，尤其是欧洲的学科重要组成部分提供了启示。

title: The Rising Tide Lifts Some Interest Rates: Climate Change, Natural Disasters, and Loan Pricing
title_zh: 潮涨推高部分利率：气候变化、自然灾害与贷款定价
title_primary: 潮涨推高部分利率：气候变化、自然灾害与贷款定价
title_secondary: The Rising Tide Lifts Some Interest Rates: Climate Change, Natural Disasters, and Loan Pricing
authors: RICARDO CORREA, AI HE, CHRISTOPH HERPFER, UGUR LEL
official: 官方在线 2026-07-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Banks adjust loan spreads after observing natural disasters linked to climate change. We isolate this updating process by identifying loans to borrowers at risk of, but not directly affected by, such disasters. Loan spreads for these borrowers spike in both primary and secondary markets, while no such updating occurs for non–climate‐related disasters. Evidence suggests a heightened perceived credit risk, which nonetheless cannot fully explain the increase in rates. Taken altogether, increased spreads are explained primarily by salience bias, as they are short‐lived and amplified by media attention. This salience impacts financial decisions at bank‐dependent firms.
abstract_zh: 银行在观察到与气候变化相关的自然灾害后，会调整贷款利差。我们通过识别那些面临此类灾害风险但未直接受影响的借款人的贷款，来分离这一更新过程。这些借款人的贷款利差在一级市场和二级市场均出现飙升，而与气候无关的灾害则未引发此类调整。证据表明，感知信用风险有所上升，但这并不能完全解释利率的上涨。综合来看，利差上升主要由显著性偏差解释，因其持续时间短暂且受媒体关注放大。这种显著性偏差影响了依赖银行的企业的财务决策。

title: Monetary policy and renewable energy development: a cross-country perspective
title_zh: 货币政策与可再生能源发展：跨国视角
title_primary: 货币政策与可再生能源发展：跨国视角
title_secondary: Monetary policy and renewable energy development: a cross-country perspective
authors: Haijie Wang, Tianyi Zhang, Songsai Wu, Yanchao Feng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Monetary policy shapes macroeconomic conditions and may influence renewable energy development, a key element of the transition to low-carbon growth. Using cross-country panel data covering the period from 2000 to 2021, this study investigates how the policy rate affects the development of renewable energy. Building on a standard transmission framework, the analysis considers firms’ investment behaviour and links Monetary policy to energy efficiency, credit conditions, and technological innovation. An empirical analysis is conducted using panel data methods, complemented by robustness checks to validate the results. The findings suggest that increases in the policy rate are associated with a decline in renewable energy development across countries. In terms of mechanisms, energy efficiency and credit conditions serve as key channels through which Monetary policy affects renewable energy, particularly in capital-intensive sectors. Although monetary tightening stimulates technological innovation, such technological innovation is largely concentrated in basic research and does not translate into applied technologies. The heterogeneity analysis further shows that the effects differ by income group and OECD membership status. The findings contribute cross-national empirical evidence and provide policy insights into how Monetary policy can be better designed to support the advancement of renewable energy.
abstract_zh: 货币政策塑造宏观经济环境，并可能影响可再生能源发展——这是向低碳增长转型的关键要素。本研究利用2000年至2021年的跨国面板数据，探讨政策利率如何影响可再生能源发展。基于标准传导框架，分析考虑了企业的投资行为，并将货币政策与能源效率、信贷条件和技术创新联系起来。采用面板数据方法进行实证分析，并通过稳健性检验验证结果。研究发现，政策利率上升与各国可再生能源发展水平下降相关。在机制方面，能源效率和信贷条件是货币政策影响可再生能源的关键渠道，尤其是在资本密集型行业。尽管货币紧缩刺激了技术创新，但这种创新主要集中在基础研究领域，并未转化为应用技术。异质性分析进一步表明，这种影响因收入群体和OECD成员国身份而异。本研究提供了跨国实证证据，并为如何优化货币政策设计以支持可再生能源发展提供了政策启示。

title: DP146 Endogenous Market Thinness and Stock Price Volatility
title_zh: 内生市场薄度与股票价格波动
title_primary: 内生市场薄度与股票价格波动
title_secondary: DP146 Endogenous Market Thinness and Stock Price Volatility
authors: Marco Pagano
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2006-06-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Thin equity markets cannot accommodate temporary bulges of buy or sell orders without large price movements. The resulting volatility can induce risk-averse transactors who face transaction costs to desert these markets. Thus thinness and the related price volatility may become joint self-perpetuating features of an equity market, irrespective of the volatility of asset fundamentals. If, however, appropriate incentive schemes are adopted to encourage entry by additional investors, this vicious circle can be broken, eventually shifting the market to a self-sustaining, superior equilibrium characterized by a higher number of transactors, lower price volatility and larger supply of the asset.
abstract_zh: 薄弱的股票市场无法在不引发大幅价格波动的情况下容纳临时性的买卖订单激增。由此产生的波动性可能导致面临交易成本的风险规避型交易者退出这些市场。因此，市场薄弱性及其相关的价格波动可能成为股票市场的自我强化特征，无论资产基本面波动性如何。然而，如果采用适当的激励机制鼓励更多投资者进入市场，这种恶性循环可以被打破，最终使市场转向一个自我维持的、更优的均衡状态，其特征是交易者数量更多、价格波动性更低以及资产供给量更大。

title_primary: 失落的玛丽·居里们与错失的经济增长
title_secondary: The Lost Marie Curies and Foregone Economic Growth
authors: Brouillette, Jean-Félix
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Women made up only 15% of U.S. inventors in 2024. Assuming no intrinsic gender differences in inventive potential, the scarcity of women in research reveals that the U.S. is missing out on some of its brightest minds. How costly is this talent misallocation for aggregate productivity? I develop a model of semi-endogenous growth in which individuals with heterogeneous talent choose between research and production careers. However, several barriers deter women from pursuing their comparative advantage. Lifting those barriers would increase U.S. income per person by 14.1% in the long run, compared with just 1.5% from a 30% R&D subsidy alone.
abstract_zh: 2024年，美国发明家中女性仅占15%。假设发明潜力不存在内在性别差异，女性在科研领域的稀缺表明美国正在错失部分最杰出的人才。这种人才错配对总体生产率造成了多大代价？我构建了一个半内生增长模型，在该模型中，具有异质性天赋的个体在科研与生产职业之间进行选择。然而，多重障碍阻碍了女性发挥其比较优势。消除这些障碍将使美国长期人均收入增长14.1%，而仅实施30%的研发补贴仅能带来1.5%的增长。

title: Strategic analysis of fair rank-minimizing mechanisms with agent refusal option

title_primary: 具有代理人拒绝选项的公平排名最小化机制的策略分析
title_secondary: Strategic analysis of fair rank-minimizing mechanisms with agent refusal option
authors: Yasunori Okumura
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates the strategic implications of the uniform rank-minimizing mechanism (URM), an assignment rule that selects uniformly from the set of deterministic assignments minimizing the sum of agents'reported ranks. We focus on settings in which agents may refuse their assignment and instead receive an outside option. Without the refusal option, we show that truth-telling is not strictly dominated under any fair rank-minimizing mechanism; that is, one satisfying equal treatment of equals. However, introducing the refusal option significantly changes strategic incentives: specific manipulations, called outside option demotion strategies, dominate truth-telling under the URM. Moreover, such manipulations can lead to inefficient outcomes, as desirable objects may be refused by misreporting agents and consequently remain unassigned. To address this issue, we propose a modification of the URM that restores undominated truth-telling, although it introduces incentives to underreport acceptable objects. Our results highlight a fundamental trade-off in the design of fair rank-minimizing mechanisms when agents can refuse their assignments.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了统一秩最小化机制（URM）的战略含义，该机制是一种从使代理人报告秩总和最小的确定性分配集合中均匀选择的分配规则。我们聚焦于代理人可能拒绝其分配结果并转而接受外部选项的情境。在没有拒绝选项的情况下，我们证明在任何公平的秩最小化机制下，即满足同等对待同等者的机制中，真实报告并非严格劣势策略。然而，引入拒绝选项显著改变了战略激励：在URM下，特定操纵策略，即所谓的外部选项降级策略，优于真实报告。此外，此类操纵可能导致无效率的结果，因为虚报代理人可能拒绝理想物品，从而导致这些物品最终未被分配。为解决此问题，我们提出对URM进行修改，以恢复非劣势的真实报告，尽管这引入了低报可接受物品的激励。我们的结果凸显了在代理人可拒绝其分配时，设计公平秩最小化机制中的基本权衡。

title: Electrification, clean cooking technologies and gender inequality: policy insight from Sub-Saharan Africa
title_zh: 电气化、清洁烹饪技术与性别不平等：来自撒哈拉以南非洲的政策启示
title_primary: 电气化、清洁烹饪技术与性别不平等：来自撒哈拉以南非洲的政策启示
title_secondary: Electrification, clean cooking technologies and gender inequality: policy insight from Sub-Saharan Africa
authors: Alex O. Acheampong, Eric Evans Osei Opoku, Kingsley E. Dogah, Josephine Frempong
official: 官方在线 2025-09-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: One of the key recommendations from the International Energy Agency Global Commission on People-Centred Clean Energy Transitions meeting is to integrate gender, equality, and social considerations into energy transition policies. The majority of the population in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA) currently lacks access to clean, modern and reliable energy, prompting numerous policies aimed at improving universal energy access in the region. SSA’s energy access deficit disproportionately impacts women, many of whom spend substantial productive hours on unpaid tasks like searching for and collecting firewood. This study investigates whether universal access to clean, modern, and reliable energy fosters gender equality in SSA. In particular, the analysis focuses on electrification and clean cooking technologies’ impact on gender inequality, using data from 41 SSA countries spanning 2000 to 2022. The findings based on the Panel Corrected Standard Error model reveal that electrification and clean cooking technologies contribute significantly to decreasing gender inequality in SSA. These results remain consistent across income groups and are robust when addressing endogeneity with Lewbel’s two-stage least-squares estimator and accounting for distributional heterogeneity via the method of moment quantile regression. The policy implication of our findings is that energy policies that support universal energy accessibility could effectively promote gender equality in SSA.
abstract_zh: 国际能源署以人为本的清洁能源转型全球委员会会议提出的关键建议之一，是将性别、平等和社会考量纳入能源转型政策。撒哈拉以南非洲（SSA）的大多数人口目前缺乏清洁、现代且可靠的能源获取途径，这促使该地区出台了众多旨在改善普遍能源获取的政策。SSA的能源获取缺口对女性的影响尤为严重，许多女性将大量生产性时间花费在寻找和收集柴火等无偿任务上。本研究探讨了普遍获取清洁、现代且可靠能源是否有助于促进SSA的性别平等。具体而言，分析聚焦于电气化和清洁烹饪技术对性别不平等的影响，使用了2000年至2022年间41个SSA国家的数据。基于面板校正标准误模型的发现表明，电气化和清洁烹饪技术显著有助于减少SSA的性别不平等。这些结果在不同收入群体中保持一致，并在使用Lewbel两阶段最小二乘估计器处理内生性以及通过矩分位数回归方法考虑分布异质性时依然稳健。我们研究结论的政策含义是，支持普遍能源获取的能源政策能有效促进SSA的性别平等。

title: Hierarchical and dynamic risk transmission mechanisms in Chinese systemically important banks
title_zh: 中国系统重要性银行的分层与动态风险传导机制
title_primary: 中国系统重要性银行的分层与动态风险传导机制
title_secondary: Hierarchical and dynamic risk transmission mechanisms in Chinese systemically important banks
authors: Lun Gao Haochen Guo a Post-doctoral Station in Applied Economics, Business School, Nanjing University, Nanjing, Chinab Post-doctoral Programme, Bank of Nanjing, Nanjing 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study explores the hierarchical and dynamic mechanisms of risk transmission among China’s systemically important banks. Given China’s hybrid financial system – characterized by state intervention, rapid market reforms and increasing global integration – systemic risk propagation remains underexplored and critically important. This article fills this research gap by employing a multilayer dynamic network model based on stock price return data from 19 systemically important banks from January 2020 to July 2024. The model integrates both linear and nonlinear interbank relationships through Pearson and Spearman correlations and captures directional causal relationships using Granger causality tests. The Planar Maximal Filter Graph (PMFG) method optimizes the network structure, effectively identifying critical transmission pathways and pivotal banks acting as risk propagators or receivers. Our empirical findings highlight distinct interdependencies and evolving risk propagation paths, revealing that certain banks consistently function as central nodes in systemic risk transmission, with their roles dynamically shifting in response to economic fluctuations. These results underline the importance of adopting multilayer dynamic approaches for accurate systemic risk assessment. Furthermore, the study provides practical implications for financial regulators by offering a framework to detect, monitor and mitigate systemic risks in real-time, thus enhancing financial system stability.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了中国系统重要性银行间风险传递的层级性与动态机制。鉴于中国混合金融体系的特点——政府干预、快速市场改革及日益增强的全球一体化——系统性风险的传播机制尚未得到充分研究，且具有至关重要的意义。本文通过构建基于2020年1月至2024年7月19家系统重要性银行股价收益率数据的多层动态网络模型，填补了这一研究空白。该模型通过Pearson和Spearman相关系数整合了银行间线性与非线性关联，并利用Granger因果检验捕捉方向性因果关系。平面最大过滤图（PMFG）方法优化了网络结构，有效识别了关键传递路径及作为风险传播者或接收者的核心银行。实证研究结果揭示了显著的相互依赖性和不断演变的风险传播路径，表明某些银行在系统性风险传递中始终充当中心节点，其角色随经济波动而动态变化。这些结果强调了采用多层动态方法进行准确系统性风险评估的重要性。此外，本研究为金融监管机构提供了实用启示，构建了一个实时检测、监测和缓解系统性风险的框架，从而增强金融体系的稳定性。

title: The incidence of rent subsidies: Evidence on rents, housing choices and supply
title_zh: 租金补贴的影响：租金、住房选择与供给的证据
title_primary: 租金补贴的影响：租金、住房选择与供给的证据
title_secondary: The incidence of rent subsidies: Evidence on rents, housing choices and supply
authors: Essi Eerola, Teemu Lyytikäinen, Tuukka Saarimaa, Tuuli Vanhapelto
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2024-01-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper asks whether, and under which circumstances, rent subsidies to low-income households increase rents. We study a reform of the Finnish housing allowance system that caused large quasi-random variation in housing allowances. Using register data spanning five years before and after the reform, we find that large increases in allowances for affected housing units had little or no effect on their rents relative to other units. The effect of a one-euro increase in housing allowance on rent is roughly 0.036 euros with a standard error of 0.028. We provide novel evidence on the underlying demand- and supply-side responses that drive the rent effects. The reform led to only small changes in recipients’ housing choices, and at most modest changes in rental supply. Our interpretation is that rent subsidies can be effective in helping recipient households even in supply-constrained contexts, if recipients’ housing choices are unresponsive to the subsidy.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨租金补贴在何种情况下会提高低收入家庭的租金水平。我们以芬兰住房补贴制度改革为研究对象，该改革导致住房补贴出现准随机大幅波动。基于改革前后五年的登记数据，我们发现受改革影响的住房单元在获得大幅补贴增加后，其租金相对于其他单元几乎没有变化。每增加1欧元住房补贴对租金的影响约为0.036欧元，标准误差为0.028。我们提供了关于驱动租金效应的需求侧与供给侧反应的新证据。改革仅导致受助者住房选择发生微小变化，租赁供给的调整幅度也极为有限。我们的解释是：若受助者的住房选择对补贴不敏感，即使面临供给约束，租金补贴仍能有效帮助受助家庭。
